papers.title: EchoHawk: A Reproducible Acoustic Pipeline for Drone Detection, Classification, and Direction-Finding, with a Cautionary Study of Session-Level Data Leakage
claims: Session-level leakage: DroneAudioDataset ships 1,332 drone files drawn from only 257 continuous recording sessions, so a naive clip-level split puts adjacent slices of one recording into both train and test. Negatives come from ESC-50 and a Speech Commands corpus.
ABSTRACT figure: enforcing recording-session-grouped cross-validation reduces 'for example' a random-forest baseline's Pd at 1% FAR from 0.796 to 0.745.
TABLE 2 figure: under proper grouping the random-forest baseline reaches 72.3% +/- 4.7% Pd@1%FAR and a CNN reaches 93.8%.

DISCREPANCY, unresolved: 0.745 (abstract) and 0.723 (Table 2) are not the same number. The paper evaluates both a synthetic benchmark and real recorded audio and the abstract does not say which its example is drawn from. Do not quote either as 'the' baseline without saying which.
Pipeline detects rotor harmonics, estimates blade-passing frequency, localises via delay-and-sum, MVDR, MUSIC, GCC-PHAT, SRP-PHAT, then temporal tracking.
Claims all code, a synthetic data generator, unit tests and figures are released. NO REPOSITORY URL APPEARS ANYWHERE IN THE PAPER, so 'runs without any download' is not actionable.

papers.title: CST Anti-UAV: A Thermal Infrared Benchmark for Tiny UAV Tracking in Complex Scenes
claims: 220 video sequences, over 240k bounding box annotations, frame-level attribute annotations, emphasis on tiny UAV targets.
State of the art reaches only 35.92% state accuracy on CST Anti-UAV, against 67.69% on Anti-UAV410.
20 existing single-object-tracking methods evaluated; the paper does not name which achieves 35.92%.
Stated as 'about to be publicly released' at time of writing; no download URL given on the abstract page.

papers.title: UAUTrack: Towards Unified Multimodal Anti-UAV Visual Tracking
claims: Single-stream, single-stage, end-to-end unified tracker across RGB, TIR and RGB-T.
Introduces a text prior prompt strategy that directs the model to attend to UAVs across scenarios.
Reports state of the art on Anti-UAV and DUT Anti-UAV, and an accuracy/speed trade-off on Anti-UAV410.
Abstract states no numeric deltas over prior SOTA; the comparison tables did not extract from the PDF.

mechanisms.summary: Split train and eval by recording session, not by clip. Adjacent slices of one continuous recording are near-duplicates; putting them on both sides of the split measures memorisation of the session, not detection of the target.
preconditions: the dataset is segmented from longer continuous captures
a session, recording, site or device identifier exists per sample
mechanisms.cost: free — it is an evaluation protocol change, not a model change

mechanisms.summary: Detect from rotor harmonic structure and estimate blade-passing frequency, rather than from a generic spectrogram classifier. Gives a physically interpretable feature that a ground-vehicle confuser does not reproduce.
preconditions: sample rate resolves the harmonic series

mechanisms.summary: Evaluate against deliberate low-frequency harmonic confusers such as ground vehicles, not against silence. A detector that separates drone from quiet is not the same as one that separates drone from truck.
preconditions: a confuser class can be sourced or synthesised

mechanisms.summary: Condition a tracker on a text prior so attention is steered to the target class across heterogeneous scenes, unifying RGB, TIR and fused streams in one model instead of one model per modality.

Forecast the target's next state in the model's own feature space rather than in pixels, using a small world model over a frozen backbone. Aimed at carrying a track through occlusion and through frames where the target is too small to detect.
preconditions: a frozen backbone whose feature space is stable

mechanisms.summary: Post-train a perception model with GRPO against a task reward, sampling a group of outputs per input and normalising advantage within the group. No critic, so cheaper than PPO.
preconditions: sampling multiple outputs per input is affordable

mechanisms.summary: Adapt at test time with GRPO and no labels, so a detector can specialise to the deployment session it is currently in.
mechanisms.cost: moderate at inference, and note it interacts badly with session-grouped evaluation

mechanisms.summary: Train across an explicit SNR ladder rather than at a single operating point, using a dataset whose SNR range is documented and wide.
preconditions: SNR is known or controllable per sample
